Two million litres of water per day is passing through a sedimentation tank which is 6 m wide, 15 m long and having a water depth of 3 m. The ratio of average flow velocity through the tank in (cm/minutes) to that of detention time of tank (in hours) is _______.
(Correct upto two decimal places).
Which of the following statements is/are true about modes of formation of particulate matter?

options.html: Fumes are fine, solid particles formed by the condensation of vapors of solid materials.
Mist consists of liquid particles formed by the atomization of parent liquid.
Spray consists of liquid particles or droplets formed by the condensation of a vapor, the dispersion of a liquid or the enactment of a chemical reaction.
Smokes are fine, solid particles resulting from incomplete combustion of organic particles.

questions.solution:
(a, d)
• Mist consists of liquid particles or droplets formed by the condensation of a vapor, the dispersion of a liquid, or the enactment of a chemical reaction.
• Spray consists of liquid particles formed by atomization of parent liquid.
